summary_en: The study tests TOS-358, a covalent PI3K-alpha inhibitor, in women with HR-positive, HER2-negative metastatic breast cancer. TOS-358 is taken by mouth once or twice a day in the dose-finding part, and in the combination part it is given with fulvestrant (injection into the muscle) and a CDK4/6 inhibitor at standard doses; treatment duration is not stated. The main outcomes are the maximum tolerated dose and recommended phase 2 dose, along with safety and tolerability (Phase 1).
summary_es: El estudio prueba TOS-358, un inhibidor covalente de PI3K-alfa, en mujeres con cáncer de mama metastásico HR positivo y HER2 negativo. TOS-358 se toma por vía oral una o dos veces al día en la parte de búsqueda de dosis, y en la parte combinada se administra con fulvestrant (inyección intramuscular) y un inhibidor de CDK4/6 a dosis estándar; la duración del tratamiento no se indica. Los resultados principales son la dosis máxima tolerada y la dosis recomendada para la fase 2, además de la seguridad y la tolerancia (Fase 1).
who_for: Locally advanced, recurrent, or metastatic HR-positive, HER2-negative breast cancer
Up to 3 prior lines of therapy for metastatic disease
Known PIK3CA mutation or amplification confirmed by a validated test
not_for: Type 1 diabetes or uncontrolled type 2 diabetes
Known active brain or central nervous system metastases
Fasting plasma glucose above 140 mg/dL or HbA1c above 7.0%
